dedupe_keys.name: survey data collected for 3 case study pilot water users associations wuas of fergana valley

description: MELDATA publishes survey data for three pilot water users’ associations in the Fergana Valley. The native metadata identifies Tajikistan and Uzbekistan and a collection period of 2 March to 26 June 2015. The file directory names water supply, infrastructure, background water demands, finance, organizational structure, staff and general-information CSVs, with data dictionaries. These source-declared subjects describe irrigation service organizations and their infrastructure, supporting capacity planning through representation of water supply and management arrangements. Individual variables, units, surveyed association names, respondent coverage and model compatibility are not established by the short description or filenames. The deposit is distinct from crop-level irrigation experiments and from water-supply allocation data for California. Access: the native repository lists public files and free access under CC-BY-NC-4.0. Caveats: no dataset files were downloaded; actual contents, completeness and numerical quality were not checked. Related resources are linked through the MELDATA parent collection.
